description: Cut P99 latency 70% (41ms to 12ms) on validate_token (6M req/hr, 1.7K RPS) by designing a Redis hash-map cache (cache-aside + TTL + invalidation on force-logout/update), eliminating 95% of PostgreSQL SELECTs and ending SLA breaches (4/11 weeks to 0).

Built an in-house SMS circuit breaker in Node.js + TypeScript tracking vendor health scores (error rate + latency) in Redis via webhooks — auto-routes traffic to healthy vendors and retries failed messages, reducing delivery failures to near 0% and eliminating manual intervention.

Reduced KYC median TAT 65% (148s to 52s) for 20M+ users by architecting the Reverse Penny Drop (RPD) flow on Ruby on Rails, driving +5% KYC to BAV and +6% Signup to NAP conversion uplift in production.
Built a Kafka-backed event-routing layer with idempotent event IDs, exponential-backoff retries and a Dead Letter Queue — sustaining 2ms per-event overhead with zero-downtime vendor migration.
Reduced daily session drops 80% (800+ to 150) by root-causing an auto-logout incident (timezone drift + device-token staleness) via Datadog APM and PagerDuty triage.
Lifted user retention 20% by rearchitecting mentor-dashboard data flows and community-feed pagination on Node.js + MongoDB, improving API reliability for 600+ active users.
Shipped booking, editing, and cancellation REST APIs end-to-end; resolved 15+ production bugs, cutting user-reported errors by 30%.
Designed and shipped a JWT + RBAC authentication service on Node.js + TypeScript with secure session management and multi-role access control for a real-estate social platform.
Engineered compound-indexed MongoDB schemas reducing feed-query P95 latency 40%; built content APIs for posts, stories and events with optimised aggregation pipelines.
